items.html: And so it was now in Assiya and Yetzira. For Assiya was in the four last Sefirot of Yetzira, back to back, and when the time of evening twilight came, then all ten Sefirot of Assiya rose upward, and Assiya turned her face toward the face of Yetzira, face to face, similar to ZA and his Nukva, as mentioned.
